facts.fact: The CSGR-IA, the Gabonese scientific committee on AI research, presents Obone AI, described as the first Gabonese AI system able to process and answer in the Fang language.

GAB.note: Release is not dated; the document describes the system as existing.
Cites the personal data law 025/2023 and ordinance 0006/PR/2025 on digitalisation without saying they cover state data.
